title: Step 67-G Admin dashboard foundation and global operational states
description: MEDIUM-risk Admin frontend stage. Implement the AD-B-03 overview as an unavailable-only dashboard foundation, expose only already-authorized static destinations, and establish reusable loading/empty/error/denied/conflict states. GET /admin/dashboard remains unresolved/not granted and must not be consumed. No Backend, OpenAPI, database, Product Design, later-domain workspace or business-metric authority is introduced.

dashboard_authority.allowed: Unavailable panel plus already-authorized static destination links only

recovery_rules: Read failure allows an explicit safe refresh; no blind mutation retry.
Denied state reveals no entity existence, counts, PII or secret metadata.
Conflict stops mutation, requires authoritative reread and forbids silent overwrite.
Loading preserves structural context and does not fabricate success.
explicitly_deferred: Any dashboard KPI, count, health, notification or business metric until runtime and permission authority is reconciled

acceptance_criteria.description: AD-B-03 renders an explicit unavailable-only overview and never calls GET /admin/dashboard.
No KPI, count, health, notification or business metric is fabricated; no dashboard success state is claimed.
Overview offers only destination links already filtered by the authenticated server-derived permission context.
Reusable loading, empty, error, denied and conflict state primitives exist with Persian RTL-safe copy and accessible status semantics.
Authentication-context unavailability and deep-link denial reuse the global state primitive without leaking protected metadata.
Conflict guidance requires authoritative reread and forbids silent overwrite or blind mutation replay.
Loading state preserves page structure and does not represent success or stale data as authoritative.
No Backend/OpenAPI/database/Storefront/Product Design/current-state or Steps 68-73 domain mutation is introduced.
Admin typecheck, lint, SSR build and deterministic 67-G verifier are integrated into the workspace verify chain.

MEDIUM-risk closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge Canonical CI/Phase A/CodeQL and terminal Lock release; no Owner Human Gate is required.
